notes.title: Demo coming and addressing the negative reviews and difficulty.
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just letting you all know that I'll be releasing a demo for Infinity Saga so people who are skeptical about buying it will give it try. Although the game is cheap, many people think the game may be another cannon fodder RPG Maker game. However, those who have played the game know it has heart, and for that I thank you!
This game is 7-9 hours long depending on your style of play. If you compare this game to other RPG Maker Games that charge $10-$20, I think it's a steal. Especially considering some of those $10-$20 games only have less than 4 hours of playable content. (In my opinion that is a ripoff.)

Now to the 3 negative reviews this game has recieved. If you look at the time the users spent playing, it's less than 20-30 minutes. Except for one user who probably just left it running to get the trading cards and badges. One review in particular says that the game is explained in the description on this store page. That is a lie, and this review has been flagged for falsifying information pertaining to my game. 

Look everyone, If you give it a try and like it, that's awesome! If you don't like it, that's fine as well. Gamers are different! 

This is why I'm putting a demo up for everyone who wants to try the game!

As for the difficulty... Git Gud.

If you have any questions, let me know!

notes.title: Halloween DLC Wallpaper, Icon Bundle, and Upcoming Discount!!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! I've been wanting to do a special Halloween update since the game came out. It's been since February 29th! So that was a long wait for me. 
To show my appreciation for everyone who has purchased the game or plans on purchasing it, I have added DLC Wallpapers and Icons!
If you already have Infinity Saga or just purchased it, all you need to do is restart Steam and let it update, then start the game and let it update, finally go to the Infinity Saga root folder then to the DLC folder and enjoy!

Also between October 17 till October 31st "Infinity Saga" will be discounted!

I hope everyone enjoys this little treat!

notes.title: Update #2 Incoming!
notes.content:
So I've updated Infinity Saga! That's the good news!
I fixed the sound option for you all complaining about it. You now have a volume control option in the Menu Settings!

Now for the bad news :(.
Since I had to go into the main script and edit it, the older save files have been corrupted. That means if you were really far along in the game your saves before this update will not work. I'm sorry and I apologize for any inconvenience, but at least now you can adjust the music and sounds so that they don't make your ears bleed when you have headphones on.

I'm thinking about compensating you all for the slight inconvenience, so in the next update, I'll give you all something extra!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Infinity Saga will be updated today, fixing a small bug issue after the first boss battle!

Also, for you who are experiencing a flicker effect when going to full screen, that is something to do with how your nvidia graphics card works. In order to fix this problem. Go to where Infinity Saga is installed. 

Steam > steamapps > common > Infinity Saga

There should be a red icon (looks like a dragon head) that say's "Game"
Right click on it and click "Run with Graphics Processor" And select "Intergrated Graphics"

This should fix the flickering. As a side not, you can go into the Nvidia control panel and set the game to open with intergrated graphic's card as well.

notes.title: Full Screen and a little walkthrough
notes.content:
If you're like me, and like to play in full screen, all you have to do is hit Alt+ Enter! That should put you in full screen mode!

Also I've seen some players struggling with the Forest Labyrinth Zone of my game. So I made a little walk-through. Remember, sometimes it's just better to run, than stay and risk a fight at low health! 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4tDtZ37DZDA
